method:
Southern work props through native UI and ordinary-time software Chromium.

A disposable profile imports the checked-in command-earned Chapter I checkpoint
as a new character. Visible Roads/trail routes, accept/step/choice/claim controls,
WASD/F/G, pause and V own all movement/progression. No test mode, coordinate write,
direct rule command, accelerated tick, progress grant or personal save is used.
Read-only observers inspect actual production submissions. Labelled appearance-
only one-frame ablations preserve identical render arguments and restore writer,
batches, state, camera and collision before the next simulation frame. A labelled
native-storage quota refusal tests the real UI save boundary and is restored.
This is software integration/pixel evidence, not hardware cost or human approval.

atlantis.title: A Chart With Room for Depth
atlantis.summary: Sahra needs one visitor chart that distinguishes the old lower road, the modern wet lane and Bellglass’s air court. Read both depth marks, correct the chart in the court, and add a modern marker beside the old masonry.
atlantis.danger: This job enters the existing bounded gallery. F ascends, G descends, and depth holds when released. The visitor envelope has no breath timer. Bellglass’s doorway and the east wet lane remain the way out; free passage home remains available.
atlantis.completionText: “There. A traveler can see the depth before choosing the lane. The older mark keeps its place, and the new one says what is safe today.” Sahra keeps the corrected visitor chart. This small commission does not settle the missing cargo or the harbour’s disputed receipts.

steps.name: Read the upper visitor gauge
steps.text: The bronze gauge labels a shallower visitor depth. Read it from the water at this level; the public deck overhead is a separate road. Sahra’s instrument records this first depth without taking any material.

steps.name: Compare the old lower-road mark
steps.text: Descend to the older worked-stone mark. Its lower depth differs from the visitor gauge. The old address is still useful history: copy the mark, leave the masonry intact, and carry both readings to Bellglass.

steps.name: Correct the chart in the Bellglass air court
steps.text: The two readings cannot share one flat route line. At the dry court desk, choose a chart that names both depth layers, marks their connection and shows the court’s doorway. You can correct a mistaken choice without spending supplies.

choices.label: Draw one flat line through every marker
choices.text: The marks have different measured depths. One flat line hides the change and makes the court look like part of the wet lane. Keep the readings and try another chart.

choices.label: Show two depth layers, their connection and the air-court doorway
choices.text: The chart distinguishes the shallower visitor gauge, the lower old road and the dry court. It also marks the east wet lane to the far landing. These lines describe the actual bounded passage.

choices.label: Erase the old mark and draw only the modern lane
choices.text: The modern lane needs a clear marker, but the old address is still evidence. Add the present safe route without deleting the lower-road record. No supplies are spent by this choice.

steps.name: Fit the modern landing marker
steps.text: Leave through Bellglass’s open doorway, follow the wet east lane, and place the new marker beside the far landing. It names today’s visitor route; the old lower-road mark remains. Return to Sahra on the dry civic road to claim the declared payment.

earthlands.title: Wood, Reed and a Road Home
earthlands.summary: Vessa offers one supply commission across Coastward’s coppice and shore spurs. Prepare a fallen bough, a small reed bundle and loose shore stone, then pack the job supplies beside the bridge. The paid bundle uses existing crafting materials.
earthlands.danger: The coppice has one territorial skitter farther south. The northern lip of the spur gives a clear approach to the fallen bough. No fight is required. Stay on the supported road and shore overlook; this outing adds no Earth swimming, boats or harvesting of standing trees.
earthlands.completionText: “Sound bough, tied reeds, loose stone. You brought back useful things without taking the shelter trees.” Vessa releases the six timber, four meadow fibre and two stone from this one commission. They can supply an ashwood trail bow at an existing workbench, or another existing recipe you choose. The road and bridge stay open.

steps.name: Prepare the fallen coppice bough
steps.text: Follow the north side of the coppice spur to the loose fallen bough. Trim and tie the sound pieces for Vessa’s order. The standing woodland trees and the existing homestead resource nodes are untouched; these pieces belong to the accepted job until its claim.

steps.name: Tie the shore reed bundle
steps.text: On the supported shore overlook, gather the marked cut reeds and tie them above the damp ground. Keep the living bank cover in place. This finite bundle is an ordinary meadow-fibre supply, not a new currency or an unlimited harvest.

steps.name: Sort the loose shore stone
steps.text: Sort the small loose stones from the marked dry stack. Leave the overlook foundation where it is. These two pieces are for Vessa’s order; Darric’s reserved public stone, the quarry story and all earlier payouts keep their separate ownership.

steps.name: Pack the three supplies by the bridge
steps.text: Return by the east woodland road and the physical timber bridge. Tie the three prepared supplies into one load at the arrival bank, then speak to Vessa nearby. Packing records the completed job; the declared materials enter your ordinary inventory only when its once-only claim succeeds.

definition.name: Earth · Coastward Road
definition.kicker: Broader Earth foundation · provisional local geography
definition.description: A long channel bridge opens onto woodland lanes, working fields and a small roadside settlement. Coastward Road is a provisional extension; Hearthwater and its people retain their existing places and history. Two western junctions continue into Elderweald-facing woodland, an inhabited clearing, a wetland footbridge and an ancient root-channel passage.
definition.sourceNotes: Original opening inspired by Earth E02 Crownfields, E05 Reedmere and E08 Rainward. Coastward Road, Merren and Vessa are new provisional names, not recovered manuscript canon. The Elderweald-facing circuit adapts Earth E03 and ET11/ET12; its local people and work remain original provisional implementation.

points.name: Return to Firstlight checkpoint
points.text: The home road is always open.
points.detail: Return directly to your original Firstlight checkpoint, or follow the nearby signed road through Hearthwater. Existing Earth stories keep their own history.

points.name: Vessa · bridge keeper
points.text: A bridge is only impressive if the next person can cross it.
points.detail: Vessa is an original provisional local. The channel crossing and both woodland lanes lead to the fields; the coppice branch is optional.

points.name: The channel crossing
points.text: A continuous timber crossing joins both banks.
points.detail: The bridge is real supported ground with two solid rails. No swimming or boat control is implied.

points.name: Rainward-facing overlook
points.text: Beyond the worked fields, the water opens toward the coast.
points.detail: Rainward belongs to Earth. This is a local coastal outlook, not a completed port or the whole Earth map.

points.name: Merren · field steward
points.text: Check the water, pack the named load, then register it. I would rather have one dependable evening than a heroic story about ruined cabbages.
points.detail: Merren is an original provisional local. The field-water and produce commission is ordinary work; it does not advance the prophecy or replace Fenna’s existing delivery.

points.name: Field-water catch
points.text: Check the catch and record the working field-water gauge.
points.detail: The catch belongs to these fields. This is a bounded work interaction, not a fluid simulation or a repair of Ansel’s existing mill.

points.name: The evening produce load
points.text: Pack the declared roadside produce load.
points.detail: Work applies only to this commission. Decorative vegetables do not become free inventory or an unlimited harvest.

points.name: Roadside delivery register
points.text: Enter the named load and its field-water check in the local register.
points.detail: This register records the local work. It does not invent online trading or replay Bellweather’s existing story reward.

points.name: Hearthwater road · home and Oren’s workshop
points.text: The channel-bank track joins the orchard and ridge roads.
points.detail: Continue on foot through the local scene boundary. The original Firstlight checkpoint remains unchanged; walking accepts no quest or reward.

points.name: Rill · forestkeeper
points.text: The road stays open. Take a look at the load before choosing what to carry.
points.detail: A local keeper at an ordinary working camp. The work is offered; entering the country accepts nothing.

points.name: Sela · herbalist
points.text: The reeds mark wet ground. Keep the walking line firm and leave the living beds alone.
points.detail: A quiet stop beside the wetland edge; no new harvesting or allegiance follows this conversation.

points.name: Camp preparation
points.text: Read the load before choosing material.
points.detail: An open packing space beside the camp.

points.name: Stormfall stock
points.text: Storm-fallen timber lies beside the track.
points.detail: This original set dressing is distinct from an inventory grant.

points.name: Managed growth
points.text: A marked working stand offers a different allocation.
points.detail: An ordinary designated work area; standing scenery is not harvestable.

points.name: Wetland edge
points.text: Read the wet ground before placing a support.
points.detail: The river gap has one supported footbridge; the reeds are scenery.

points.name: Root-channel load
points.text: Look down the open root channel before entering.
points.detail: The route passes between the original masonry flanks. Its overhead roots clear a standing traveller.

points.name: Root-channel support
points.text: A support station stands beyond the passage.
points.detail: The open working space is south of both flank walls.

points.name: Return glade delivery
points.text: The return track opens into a packing glade.
points.detail: A local delivery point; the ordinary road continues back to Coastward.

quest.title: Water, fields and the evening load
quest.completionText: The local field-water check, produce packing and delivery record are complete. Merren can account for this evening’s work; the older Hearthwater delivery keeps its own history.

Coastward Road is a provisional extension; Hearthwater and its people retain their existing places and history. Two western junctions continue into Elderweald-facing woodland, an inhabited clearing, a wetland footbridge and an ancient root-channel passage.
definition.sourceNotes: Original opening inspired by Earth E02 Crownfields, E05 Reedmere and E08 Rainward. Coastward Road, Merren and Vessa are new provisional names, not recovered manuscript canon. The Elderweald-facing circuit adapts Earth E03 and ET11/ET12; its local people and work remain original provisional implementation.

points.name: Return to Firstlight checkpoint
points.text: The home road is always open.
points.detail: Return directly to your original Firstlight checkpoint, or follow the nearby signed road through Hearthwater. Existing Earth stories keep their own history.

points.name: Vessa · bridge keeper
points.text: A bridge is only impressive if the next person can cross it.
points.detail: Vessa is an original provisional local. The channel crossing and both woodland lanes lead to the fields; the coppice branch is optional.

points.name: The channel crossing
points.text: A continuous timber crossing joins both banks.
points.detail: The bridge is real supported ground with two solid rails. No swimming or boat control is implied.

points.name: Rainward-facing overlook
points.text: Beyond the worked fields, the water opens toward the coast.
points.detail: Rainward belongs to Earth. This is a local coastal outlook, not a completed port or the whole Earth map.

points.name: Merren · field steward
points.text: Check the water, pack the named load, then register it. I would rather have one dependable evening than a heroic story about ruined cabbages.
points.detail: Merren is an original provisional local. The field-water and produce commission is ordinary work; it does not advance the prophecy or replace Fenna’s existing delivery.

points.name: Field-water catch
points.text: Check the catch and record the working field-water gauge.
points.detail: The catch belongs to these fields. This is a bounded work interaction, not a fluid simulation or a repair of Ansel’s existing mill.

points.name: The evening produce load
points.text: Pack the declared roadside produce load.
points.detail: Work applies only to this commission. Decorative vegetables do not become free inventory or an unlimited harvest.

points.name: Roadside delivery register
points.text: Enter the named load and its field-water check in the local register.
points.detail: This register records the local work. It does not invent online trading or replay Bellweather’s existing story reward.

points.name: Hearthwater road · home and Oren’s workshop
points.text: The channel-bank track joins the orchard and ridge roads.
points.detail: Continue on foot through the local scene boundary. The original Firstlight checkpoint remains unchanged; walking accepts no quest or reward.

points.name: Rill · forestkeeper
points.text: The road stays open. Take a look at the load before choosing what to carry.
points.detail: A local keeper at an ordinary working camp. The work is offered; entering the country accepts nothing.

points.name: Sela · herbalist
points.text: The reeds mark wet ground. Keep the walking line firm and leave the living beds alone.
points.detail: A quiet stop beside the wetland edge; no new harvesting or allegiance follows this conversation.

points.name: Camp preparation
points.text: Read the load before choosing material.
points.detail: An open packing space beside the camp.

points.name: Stormfall stock
points.text: Storm-fallen timber lies beside the track.
points.detail: This original set dressing is distinct from an inventory grant.

points.name: Managed growth
points.text: A marked working stand offers a different allocation.
points.detail: An ordinary designated work area; standing scenery is not harvestable.

points.name: Wetland edge
points.text: Read the wet ground before placing a support.
points.detail: The river gap has one supported footbridge; the reeds are scenery.

points.name: Root-channel load
points.text: Look down the open root channel before entering.
points.detail: The route passes between the original masonry flanks. Its overhead roots clear a standing traveller.

points.name: Root-channel support
points.text: A support station stands beyond the passage.
points.detail: The open working space is south of both flank walls.

points.name: Return glade delivery
points.text: The return track opens into a packing glade.
points.detail: A local delivery point; the ordinary road continues back to Coastward.

quest.title: Water, fields and the evening load
quest.completionText: The local field-water check, produce packing and delivery record are complete. Merren can account for this evening’s work; the older Hearthwater delivery keeps its own history.

points.name: Nereme · pilot

points.detail: The civic court and far quay have a continuous dry route. The marked gallery is a bounded visitor dive with explicit depth controls; the public visitor protection has no drowning timer.

points.name: Sahra · instrument-maker
points.text: A dial is useful when someone can compare it with what the water actually does.
points.detail: Sahra’s workshop remains distinct from Oren’s. This local inspection does not resolve Vaelor, Damar, the Custodian or the larger regional campaign.

points.text: Check the lamp marking the dry court approach.
points.detail: Confirm the ordinary visitor route. Decorative distant lights are not travel gates.

points.detail: This is a local instrument check. It does not establish the later harbour fraud or require joining a school.

points.name: Visitor route register

points.name: Gallery landing · dry exit
points.text: Leave the visitor gallery at the marked far quay.
points.detail: The landing is reachable from the wet east lane. The transfer returns to supported dry ground on the far quay.

points.name: The harbour beneath the harbour
points.text: The lower court has benches and maintained lamps, not a tomb.
points.detail: Only this small gallery and visitor air court are authored. Oristhal’s distant skyline is scenery and does not claim full-city access.

journal.text: Oren supplied a trail blade, a lantern, three tonics and a salve for an injured animal. Find the northern mine.

You entered the Rootbound Underways. Excavation and completed encounters are remembered.
Briar skitter defeated. A cache remains at its original position.
Root prowler defeated. A cache remains at its original position.
You used the trail salve to help Briar. The fox chose to follow.
Prism sentinel defeated. A cache remains at its original position.
The Hollow Hart defeated. A cache remains at its original position.
You recovered a white feather from the celestial anchor. Bring it to the Firstlight spring.
A white-winged envoy appeared: Heaven is under attack, and broken passages endanger the mortal world.
You accepted Warden’s heartstone. The first chapter is complete; the wider campaign is still to be built.
Wood, Reed and a Road Home accepted. Read the route, danger and fixed reward.

Follow the north side of the coppice spur to the loose fallen bough. Trim and tie the sound pieces for Vessa’s order. The standing woodland trees and the existing homestead resource nodes are untouched; these pieces belong to the accepted job until its claim.

On the supported shore overlook, gather the marked cut reeds and tie them above the damp ground. Keep the living bank cover in place. This finite bundle is an ordinary meadow-fibre supply, not a new currency or an unlimited harvest.

Sort the small loose stones from the marked dry stack. Leave the overlook foundation where it is. These two pieces are for Vessa’s order; Darric’s reserved public stone, the quarry story and all earlier payouts keep their separate ownership.

Return by the east woodland road and the physical timber bridge. Tie the three prepared supplies into one load at the arrival bank, then speak to Vessa nearby. Packing records the completed job; the declared materials enter your ordinary inventory only when its once-only claim succeeds.
Wood, Reed and a Road Home complete · +25 XP · +10 sunmarks · +6 wood · +4 fiber · +2 stone. The declared fee is claimed once.
A Chart With Room for Depth accepted. Read the route, danger and fixed reward.

The bronze gauge labels a shallower visitor depth. Read it from the water at this level; the public deck overhead is a separate road. Sahra’s instrument records this first depth without taking any material.

Descend to the older worked-stone mark. Its lower depth differs from the visitor gauge. The old address is still useful history: copy the mark, leave the masonry intact, and carry both readings to Bellglass.

The two readings cannot share one flat route line. At the dry court desk, choose a chart that names both depth layers, marks their connection and shows the court’s doorway. You can correct a mistaken choice without spending supplies.

Leave through Bellglass’s open doorway, follow the wet east lane, and place the new marker beside the far landing. It names today’s visitor route; the old lower-road mark remains. Return to Sahra on the dry civic road to claim the declared payment.
A Chart With Room for Depth complete · +30 XP · +12 sunmarks · +2 ore. The declared fee is claimed once.
